newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Thorn Apple EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Thorn Apple EPS view cut.

text.p: Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Friday she cut her earnings estimate for meat processor Thorn Apple Valley Inc to $0.95 a share from $1.05 previously.
-- She also cut her first quarter estimate to a loss of $0.10 a share from break-even.
-- "Pork slaughter margins through July have been pretty lousy, thus we're lowering our first-quarter expectations to show a loss," Wittenburg said in a report.
-- Thorn Apple shares closed Thursday at 18-5/16.

-- On Thursday, it reported a fourth quarter loss of $0.28 a share, compared with a year-ago loss of $1.92. Excluding a $5 million pretax restructuring charge, the fourth quarter earnings were $0.26 a share, Wittenburg said.
-- She added that the company processed 450 million pounds of meat in fiscal 1997 and will attempt to increase that amount by eight to 10 percent in fiscal 1998.

-- Commenting on her buy rating, Wittenburg said, "It is our premise that the turnaround will work at Thorn Apple Valley or the company will be taken over -- or both could happen. Under either scenario, we believe there is room for (Thorn Apple) stock to rise substantially."
